versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Huawei Cloud WAF Security Event Log Analysis skill.
- Provides read-only aggregation and analysis of WAF logs (attack types, sources, targets, time trends).
- Generates actionable, copy-paste ready protection rule recommendations based on analyzed attack data.
- Strictly enforces read-only principle and Windows PowerShell compatibility (Linux shell commands are never used).
- Requires user input for analysis scope and data volume; never defaults sampling size without confirmation.
- Delivers structured, prioritized reports with clear instructions and does not execute any modification commands.
